skill.name: deployment-validation-config-validate
skill.description: Design validation schemas, tests, environment rules, migrations, runtime checks, security controls, and documentation for application configuration files.
skill.summary: Build reliable configuration validation workflows for deployments and runtime changes.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most command, environment, certificate, and reconnaissance alerts are syntax or identifier false positives. The guidance intentionally discovers and reads .env files and demonstrates persistent file watching. Its encryption example derives keys with a fixed salt, weakening password-based key isolation.

remediation.issue: Configuration discovery includes .env files that may contain credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit scope, exclude secret files by default, and report only secret locations without values.

remediation.issue: Runtime validation watches a caller-supplied path without a demonstrated boundary check.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve and restrict paths to approved configuration roots, reject unsafe links, and provide watcher shutdown handling.

remediation.issue: The encryption example uses one fixed PBKDF2 salt for every derived key.
remediation.suggestion: Generate a random salt per protected configuration, store it with the ciphertext, and document key rotation requirements.

content.value_statement: Configuration errors can cause failed deployments, security gaps, and inconsistent environments. This skill designs schemas, tests, migrations, runtime checks, and clear configuration documentation.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes JSON, YAML, TOML, INI, environment, and JavaScript configuration locations for validation needs and secret patterns.
Designs JSON Schema validation with Ajv formats for HTTPS URLs, ports, hostnames, and durations.
Defines different validation rules for development, staging, and production environments.
Creates configuration test plans and Jest examples for valid and invalid settings.
Proposes runtime file watching, versioned configuration migrations, and encrypted value handling.
Generates configuration reference documentation from schema properties and examples.
limitations: The examples are illustrative and omit several helper methods, loaders, type guards, and production error handling.
The skill does not verify real configurations unless the agent receives approved workspace access and relevant files.
Secret detection is pattern-based and may flag harmless names or read sensitive environment files.
The encryption and file-watching examples require security review before production use.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Deployment Gate
use_cases.description: Create environment-aware schema checks and tests that reject unsafe configuration before release.

use_cases.title: Add Typed Application Settings
use_cases.description: Define required fields, formats, defaults, and useful validation errors for an application.

use_cases.title: Review Configuration Security
use_cases.description: Identify secret exposure, weak production defaults, unsafe URLs, and missing encryption controls.

prompt_templates.title: Inventory Configuration Risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review configuration files under {{project_path}}. Identify formats, environments, missing validation, and consistency risks. Do not reveal secret values.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a scoped assessment of an unfamiliar project.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Validation Schema
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a validation plan for {{config_name}}. Define required fields, types, ranges, secure formats, defaults, and readable error messages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert known configuration requirements into enforceable rules.

prompt_templates.title: Build Environment Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Design tests for development, staging, and production configuration. Cover valid settings, boundary values, forbidden production options, and missing secrets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add automated checks to a deployment pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Runtime Validation and Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Design runtime reload validation and migrations from {{current_version}} to {{target_version}}. Include rollback, path boundaries, secret handling, and failure behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create an advanced configuration lifecycle with explicit security controls.

output_examples.input: Review the production configuration for unsafe settings.
output_examples.output: Assessment: Debug mode is forbidden, external URLs require HTTPS, passwords need stronger minimum lengths, and secret values must remain redacted.

output_examples.input: Plan validation for a database configuration.
output_examples.output: Validation plan: Require hostname, port, database, user, password, and SSL status. Reject empty names, invalid ports, and incomplete SSL settings.

output_examples.input: Design a safe migration for a versioned configuration.
output_examples.output: Migration plan: Validate the source version, apply ordered changes, validate the result, preserve rollback data, and stop on unknown versions.

best_practices: Approve a narrow configuration root and redact secret values before analysis or reporting.
Validate configurations before deployment, after migration, and before accepting runtime reloads.
Test environment rules with valid cases, boundary values, missing fields, and forbidden production settings.
anti_patterns: Do not scan an entire home directory or repository for environment files without explicit approval.
Do not copy illustrative encryption code into production without independent cryptographic review.
Do not reload invalid configuration or continue silently after production validation fails.

faq.question: Which configuration formats can this skill address?
faq.answer: It covers JSON, YAML, TOML, INI, environment files, and JavaScript configuration patterns.

faq.question: Does it modify configuration files automatically?
faq.answer: Only when explicitly requested and permitted. Its primary output is analysis, validation design, tests, migrations, and documentation.

faq.question: Can it create JSON Schema rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define required properties, types, formats, ranges, defaults, and validation error handling.

faq.question: Does it support environment-specific validation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can distinguish development, staging, and production requirements such as HTTPS, debug restrictions, and password length.

faq.question: Will secret values appear in the output?
faq.answer: They should not. Restrict file scope and request redacted findings that identify locations without exposing values.

faq.question: Is the provided encryption example production-ready?
faq.answer: No. It uses a fixed salt and requires cryptographic review, key rotation planning, and stronger metadata validation.
